item.title: A sociologist’s perspective on the Jason Arday story
item.description:
The controversy surrounding Cambridge professor Jason Arday began with questions about his academic record and extraordinary personal story. It ended in tragedy. What can sociology tell us about how a scandal like this escalates once it's forced into public view?
Host Megan McArdle talks with UCLA sociologist Gabriel Rossman about scandal, status and public shaming.
Content warning: This episode includes discussion of sexual assault and suicide.
